title: Kamailio v4.3.7 Released
html:
Kamailio SIP Server v4.3.7 stable is out – a minor release including fixes in code and documentation since v4.3.6. The configuration file and database schema compatibility is preserved.

Kamailio v4.3.7 is based on the latest version of GIT branch 4.3, therefore those running previous 4.3.x versions are advised to upgrade. There is no change that has to be done to configuration file or database structure comparing with older v4.3.x.

Important Note: v4.3.7 is the last official release from branch 4.3. Therefore it is strongly advised to consider upgrading to v4.4.x or 5.0.x as soon as possible to benefit of proper source code maintenance.

Resources for Kamailio version 4.3.7

Source tarballs are available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/4.3.7/src/

Detailed changelog:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/4.3.7/ChangeLog

Download via GIT:

 # git clone git://git.kamailio.org/kamailio kamailio
 # cd kamailio
 # git checkout -b 4.3 origin/4.3

Binaries and packages will be uploaded at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/pub/kamailio/4.3.7/

Modules’ documentation:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/4.3.x/

What is new in 4.3.x release series is summarized in the announcement of v4.3.0:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v4-3-0-release-notes/

Note: the branch 4.3 is becoming an unmaintained stable branch. The maintained stable branches at this moment are 4.4 and 5.0, with v5.0.2 being released out of the latest stable branch. Therefore an alternative is to upgrade to latest 4.4.x or 5.0.x – be aware that you may need to change the configuration files and database structures from 4.3.x to 4.4.x or 5.0.x. See more details about it at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v4-4-0-release-notes/
  • https://www.kamailio.org/w/kamailio-v5-0-0-release-notes/

Thanks for flying Kamailio and enjoy the summer holidays!
